description: Create a draft eval record carrying its own executable grader. Persists it as a draft, then returns the parsed record parroted back behind a divider, a per-field review protocol, a ready-to-paste verification subagent prompt, and the self-consistency result. It stays draft — self-consistency passing proves the grader discriminates, not that the gold is right; record an independent verification (a subagent report or your own decorrelated check) before evals_submit_draft.

author_model.description: The authoring model id; stored under provenance.author_model (falls back to "unknown").

captures.description: EvalsIDs linking the fleet tool calls behind the answer; resolved from EVALS_CAPTURE_DIR at submit.

choices.description: The answer choices; required for mcq (grader.correct must equal one element).

context.description: An optional grounding passage for the task.

discrimination.description: The discrimination cases that prove the grader accepts right answers and rejects wrong ones.

negative.description: Known-wrong answers that MUST fail; at least one is required to submit.

positive.description: Answers that MUST pass the grader (gold is implicitly one).

gold.description: The reference answer; its shape depends on task_type (a number/expression for numeric, a string for exact_answer, etc.).

grader.description: The grader serialized with the record. Deterministic kinds run server-side; llm_rubric relies on recorded independent verification.

kind.description: Numeric grader — resolves target through math.js, then compares with tolerance.

rel_tol.description: Relative tolerance for the comparison (e.g. 1e-6). Defaults to 1e-9 when both tolerances are omitted.

anyOf.description: A math.js expression string, e.g. "5/14" or "combinations(5,2)/combinations(8,2)".

target.description: Reference value as a number or a math.js expression string, resolved to a number for comparison.

units.description: Expected units for documentation, e.g. "kg" — not enforced numerically.

kind.description: Gold-relative string match — grades a candidate against the record gold after normalization.

normalize.description: Normalization steps applied to both gold and candidate before exact comparison.

items.description: A normalization step applied before comparison: trim whitespace, lowercase, strip punctuation, or strip LaTeX wrappers ($, \(, \text{}).

expected.description: The expected set of string elements the candidate must contain.

kind.description: Set match — grades a candidate list/CSV against an expected set.

order_sensitive.description: When true, element order must match exactly. Defaults to unordered.

flags.description: Regex flags, e.g. "i" for case-insensitive or "m" for multiline.

kind.description: Regex grader — a candidate passes when the pattern matches it.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern (JavaScript flavor) tested against the candidate.

correct.description: The correct answer; must equal one element of the record choices[].

kind.description: Multiple-choice grader — a candidate passes when it equals the correct choice.

expected.description: A value the candidate must deep-equal (any JSON-serializable shape).

kind.description: JSON grader — a candidate must deep-equal expected and/or satisfy a JSON Schema. At least one of expected/schema is required.

schema.description: A JSON Schema object the candidate must structurally satisfy (validated by ajv at runtime).

criteria.description: The weighted criteria the judge evaluates the candidate against.

description.description: What the judge checks for this criterion.

weight.description: Relative weight in the weighted pass score (default 1).

judge_prompt.description: Instructions for the judge model on how to apply the criteria.

kind.description: LLM-judge grader specification — submission relies on recorded independent verification because this server cannot execute it.

pass_threshold.description: Minimum weighted score (0..1) for the candidate to PASS.

metadata.description: Record metadata: domain (required), tags (required), and optional license/provenance/contamination notes.

contamination_notes.description: Notes on memorization/contamination risk for this item.

license.description: SPDX-style license; defaults to EVALS_DEFAULT_LICENSE when omitted.

source_provenance.description: Citations grounding the gold; live-source verification lands here.

items.description: A ground-truth source citation grounding the gold answer.

query.description: The call or query made against that server.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the value was retrieved.

server.description: Fleet server that supplied the value, e.g. "secedgar".

uri.description: Citation or permalink for the value.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering and grouping.

prompt.description: The task shown to the model under test.

task_type.description: The eval task type. numeric: a number/expression answer; exact_answer: a normalized string; set_answer: an unordered/ordered set; mcq: a multiple-choice selection (requires choices); regex_answer: a pattern match; json_answer: a structured value; free_response: rubric-graded prose (requires an llm_rubric grader).

verification.description: Optional draft-time verification provenance, if you already have evidence (method + generation_method + evidence[]).

evidence.description: Pre-recorded verification evidence available at draft time.

items.description: A single verification evidence entry, discriminated by type.

computed.description: The value the check computed, when applicable.

tool.description: The tool or method used to compute the claim, e.g. "evals_run_check".

type.description: A deterministic re-computation or verifier run.

findings.description: The subagent report, one concise summary of issues or confirmation.

method.description: How the subagent verified the gold (for decorrelation), e.g. "independent_derivation".

type.description: A fresh-context subagent review of the draft.

source.description: The source entry that grounds the gold.

query.description: The call or query made against that server.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the value was retrieved.

server.description: Fleet server that supplied the value, e.g. "secedgar".

uri.description: Citation or permalink for the value.

type.description: A live lookup against an authoritative fleet source.

generation_method.description: How the answer was produced, for decorrelation against the verification path.

method.description: How the gold was checked, e.g. "independent_derivation".

name: evals_create_draft

draft_id.description: The assigned record id, stable across the lifecycle.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `grader_unexecutable`: The grader spec cannot run against the gold (malformed math.js target, invalid regex, missing json_match reference). `task_type_constraint`: A per-task-type rule is violated (mcq without choices; free_response without an llm_rubric grader). `mcq_choice_mismatch`: The mcq grader correct answer is not one of the choices. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

normalized_record.description: The record as the server parsed and stored it, with server-stamped id/created_at/content_hash.

required_before_submit.description: What still must be true before evals_submit_draft will accept the record.

review_protocol.description: The per-field review protocol to work through before submit.

server_checks.description: The cheap self-consistency result (not the submit gate).

gold_passes_grader.description: True when the gold passes its own grader.

grader_ok.description: True when gold + all positives pass and all negatives (≥1) are rejected.

negatives_rejected.description: Per-negative rejection verdict (true = correctly rejected), in declaration order.

positives_pass.description: Per-positive pass verdict, in declaration order.

ready_to_submit.description: True only when both grader_ok and verification_present are true.

verification_present.description: True when at least one verification.evidence entry exists.

suggested_subagent_prompt.description: A ready-to-paste prompt for a fresh verification subagent.
